understanding individual differences in the way children and adolescents use the number line.
the development of number line representation, a fundamental skill for mathematical achievement.

all four NLE accuracy indices are equally predictive and equally heritable.
the NLE task is a valid and reliable measure of math achievement.
all four measures of accuracy on the NLE task appear appropriate for prediction and modeling of mathematical ability in adolescents.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
NLE is a valid measure for predicting math achievement in adolescents and the four proposed measures of accuracy appear to be equivalent.
the four accuracy measures of NLE task performance are all valid measures of math ability.
all four NLE accuracy methods are appropriate for predicting achievement, and all four methods have a similar genetic and environmental architecture.

NLE accuracy measures are related to math achievement in a similar manner, regardless of the type used.
all four accuracy measures are appropriate and should be used in future studies to assess the NLE task.
